tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. The apps' OverviewBase: plum-black in dark, lavender-white in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Opaque panels and cards on plain canvas. Dark is the Mac sheet's tint colour (sheetTint, 26 21 36).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card or sheet: code, table headers, disabled buttons. Dark is the iOS card as it reads over plain canvas.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass fill for cards, the nav bar and secondary buttons. Always with the glass-blur backdrop and a glass-edge rim. Over the wash it picks up the purple, as the iOS cards do; over canvas it reads as a quiet plum-grey.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px inner rim on glass, the lit edge of Liquid Glass. Decorative.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the divider under the Mac sheet header and above its footer, card outlines on canvas. Decorative.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The unfilled part of a quota ring. The apps' quaternarySystemFill, raised slightly so it reads on glass. Decorative.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, service names, plan lines, body. 9:1 or better on every ground in both themes, including glass over the brightest part of the wash. The apps' OverviewPrimary.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: footnotes, 'Limit reached', the footer's Settings and timestamp, eyebrows. Plum-grey as the apps draw it (sampled #a295af on iOS). 4.5:1 or better on canvas, surface, surface-2, glass on canvas and the banner; keep it off glass on the top 200px of the wash.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Disabled labels, placeholder text, dashed 'not reported' tracks. The apps' OverviewTertiary. Fails 4.5:1 by design; never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Measuring: quota rings, heatmap highlight, focus ring, the banner tint. Apple systemPurple, as the apps draw rings. 3:1 or better as a mark on every ground except glass over the wash top in dark (2.8:1), where the ring sits on track.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Every purple word: reset times, banner links, dial numerals, plain buttons. The apps' reset ink (OverviewResetAccent, gaugeAccentInk on the Mac sheet). 4.8:1 or better on canvas, surface, surface-2, glass on canvas and the banner in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The primary button fill, both themes: the app icon's outer arc. Carries on-brand at 4.7:1. One per view.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: The iOS overview wash, the app's signature: a vertical gradient from this colour at 72% (dark) or 18% (light) at the top of the hero, through accent at 12% / 5% at 40%, to clear at 70%. Never a solid fill or text.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The Mac sheet's top-left glow (sheetGlow), an elliptical gradient to clear at 75%. Used on sheet panels and as the radial light at the top-right of the hero.

tokens.name: glow-2
tokens.usage: The Mac sheet's bottom-right counter-glow (sheetGlowTrailing), to clear at 60%.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The Mac menu-bar sheet's tint (sheetTint), laid over a blur. Large panels that show the Mac app's surface.

tokens.name: notice
tokens.usage: Fill of the reset notice banner: accent at 22%, exactly as MacResetNoticeBanner draws it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Ring and dot from 85% used. The apps' OverviewWarning. Light is 2.0:1 as a mark (kept exact from the apps); pair it with numbers in warning-ink.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning words and dial numerals at 85% or more. 4.6:1 or better on every dark ground; 4.3:1 or better on light grounds except the wash.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Ring and dot from 95% used or at the limit, as on the Mac sheet's full red dial. The apps' OverviewCritical.

tokens.name: critical-ink
tokens.usage: Critical words and dial numerals at the limit. 4.5:1 or better on canvas, surface, surface-2 and glass on canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: data-0
tokens.usage: Heatmap day with reported zero. From CodexTokenHistoryView.swift (0.30 0.28 0.34 / 0.87 0.85 0.90).

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Heatmap, lowest quartile of active days.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Heatmap, second quartile.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Heatmap, third quartile.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Heatmap, busiest quartile. Dark brightens toward use, light darkens, as in both apps.

tokens.name: icon-ground
tokens.usage: The app icon tile (icon.json, Display P3). Download bands behind the icon.

tokens.name: mark-outer
tokens.usage: The icon's outer arc. Illustration only; UI rings use accent.

tokens.name: mark-inner
tokens.usage: The icon's inner arc. Illustration only.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", "Inter", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Hero headline, once per page; 44px under 640px. Bold, like the app's own large title.
styles.sample: Know before you hit the limit.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Inner page titles. iOS Large Title, as the app sets 'AIQuota'.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Service names on hero cards, as the iOS cards set them.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card and feature headings; service names on the Mac sheet.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Plan lines, banner titles, list titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero or section heading, in ink-2.
styles.sample: AIQuota shows how much of your Codex and Claude allowance is left, in your menu bar and on your Home Screen.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, about 65 characters a line.
styles.sample: Readings come straight from each provider, so every Mac, iPhone and iPad shows the same numbers.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Reset lines, banner links, nav links, button labels. The Mac sheet's 15pt.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Short label above a heading, sentence case, ink-2.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: The percentage in a hero dial, tabular.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Dial percentage in the 248px dial: the iOS large dial's 32pt medium, tabular, in the dial's state colour.

styles.name: numeral-sm
styles.usage: Percentages inside a 124px dial: the iOS card dial's subheadline medium, tabular, in the dial's state colour. Scales with the dial.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and the brew command.

spacing.note: A 4px rhythm, the step the apps use.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between stacked reset lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a card's text stack; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tags and chips; nav link padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; compact padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid; Mac sheet side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; heading to lead.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Lead to buttons; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

radius.note: Concentric, as Liquid Glass is: inner radius = outer radius minus the padding between.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Heatmap cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small controls (Mac popover controls).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The reset banner on the Mac sheet; rows on hover.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Insets inside a card with 14px padding.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Mac sheet panels, matching the menu-bar window's corner.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Service cards and the iOS-style banner. OverviewStyle.radius.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, the nav bar, icon button groups.

shadow.note: Only floating things cast a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Mac sheet panels, the scrolled nav bar, a card floating over another.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: Dual-dial rings at card size (124px), as OverviewStyle.ringWidth. Doubles at the 248px hero size.

tokens.name: stroke-ring-single
tokens.usage: A single-window dial (7d only, or a monthly allowance), OverviewStyle.singleRingWidth.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and the glass rim.

blur.note: Backdrop filters for glass. Off with Reduce Transparency.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Light-theme glass.

tokens.name: glass-blur-dark
tokens.usage: Dark-theme glass. The darkening keeps glass over the bright top of the wash deep plum, as iOS glass does, so text stays readable.

tokens.name: opacity-secondary-ring
tokens.usage: The inner (7-day) ring, as in the apps.
